newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF to look into DKB links with racketeer.
newsitem.headline: MOF to look into DKB links with racketeer.

text.p: Kimio Yamaguchi, director-general of the Finance Ministry's banking bureau, said on Tuesday that he has instructed ministry officials to examine Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd's (DKB) links with a corporate racketeer.

"I have already instructed ministry officials to look into DKB's loans to the racketeer, but I cannot comment on the details as the issue is still under investigation," Yamaguchi told a parliamentary committee meeting.
Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told the same committee meeting that he hoped the facts concerning DKB will become clear with the investigation by prosecutors.
DKB was raided by prosecutors on Tuesday as part of a widening investigation into links between racketeers and the world of finance.

DKB has said that it regretted the raid, but stayed silent over reports that it provided questionable loans to the racketeer at the centre of the Nomura Securities Co Ltd payoff scandal, Ryuichi Koike.
